tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// rab gnas kyi yon bsgo'i bshad pa legs bshad 'od kyi snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ mchog gsum dam pa rnams kyi zhabs pad+mor// gus pas btud nas rab gnas rgyas pa'i dus// yon bdag bsgo ba'i skabs su legs bshad kyi// dga' ston spro ba'i ngo mtshar gtam 'di gling*// de yang rab gnas kyi mjug yon bdag bsgo ba'i skabs yon bdag la stan dkar nas sam 'bras kyi g.yung drung chos skor du bris pa'i steng du gos rgyan bzang pos brgyan/ slob dpon la kha phyogs par 'dug tu bcug de nas slob dpon gyis gsung dpangs mtho ba dang bcas/ 'o/ khyod kyis nga la gang gsol ba'i// sku gzugs dag ni khyad par du// ji ltar gsungs pa'i rab gnas par// de dag don ni ngas byas te// de rnams don ni grub zin gyis// ci bde bar ni mchod par byos// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khyod kyis nga la gsol ba btab pa'i rab tu gnas pa de legs par grub pa yin pas/ skabs 'dir bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par bya ba'i legs bshad kyi dga' ston cung zad spro bar bya na/ spyir rab tu gnas pa'i skad dod du/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha zhes pa rab tu gnas pa'i don yin pas/ lha dam tshig pa la ye shes pa til gyi gong bu lta bur bstim pa la rab gnas kyi tha snyad mdzad pas na/ rab tu gnas pa ni sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rtsa ba lta bu yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten byin rlabs can gang du bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs der bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa da nga*/ de'i stobs kyis yul khams rnams su yang nad dang mu ge 'khrugs rtsod med cing bde skyid gong 'phel du 'byung ba sogs phan yon dpag tu med pa 'gyur bar gsungs pa sogs sku gsung thugs rten ngo mtshar can bzhugs pa'i thugs rje yin la/ de'i rtsa ba ni/

rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rnam par dag pa nyid gal che ba lags/ de la spyir nges pa don gyi dbang du byas na/ rab tu gnas bya gnas byed dang bral ba'i phyir na rab tu gnas pa bya mi dgos te/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun ni rab tu bzhugs// rab tu gnas pa gang yang med// kun tu mkha' ltar gnas pa la// cig shos kyis ni rab tu brtags// 'jig rten kun rdzob la brten nas// rab tu gnas par brtag par bya// zhes dang*/ dam pa'i don ni spyod pa ni// gang zhig gang gis rab tu brlab// gzod ma nas ni skye med la// ci 'dras ji ltar rab tu gnas// dang po'i las can sems can rnams// rtog pa'i rgyu ru mdzad par zad// ces gsungs pas/ nges pa'i don du rab gnas sogs bya mi dgos kyang*/ kun rdzob sems can gyi don du rab tu gnas pa la 'bad par bya dgos te/ de ltar ma byas pa'i nyes pa ni/ rgyud de nyid las/ gang du sku gzugs rdzogs pa la// byin ma brlabs par ring gnas na// de la bkra mi shis 'byung zhing*// de srid mchod par de mi 'os// dper na skyes bu la la zhig /rig pa'i mtshan nyid spangs pa na// 'jig rten kun gyis mchod mi bya// de de bzhin du gzugs brnyan de// rab gnas ma byas gzugs brnyan la// gang zhig mchod cing phyag byed pa// dam tshig bral zhing sngags dman pas// sbyin sreg thal ba 'bras med mtshungs// zhes gsungs shing rab tu gnas pa'i yo byad dang*/ cho ga dman pas kyang mi bya ste/ cho ga dman pas mi bya ste// zhes pa nas/ de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis// dngos grub 'dod pas nan tan bya// zhes gsungs/ rab gnas legs par byas shing mchod pa'i phan yon ni/ rgyud las/ cho ga bdag nyid nus pa yis// brtag pa las gsungs tshul legs pas// de byas bsod nams che ba ni// mthong ngam ma mthong 'bras bu skye// sku gzugs sngags kyi mtshan nyid kyis// de la byin rlabs 'jug par 'gyur// zhes sogs rgya cher bka' stsal pa ltar/

rab gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bgyis pa'i mthu la brten nas/ 'jig rten 'dir phan zhing bde la/ phyi ma sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba yin pas/ de lta bu'i rab tu gnas pa de yang*/ bzang po drug gi sgo nas nges par bya dgos te/ skad gnyis smra ba lo chen rin chen bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rten gyi bya ba yongs rdzogs nas// slob dpon mtshan nyid gnas dang dus// yo byad yongs su tshang nas ni// cho ga dag la 'jug par bya// zhes pa dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ rab gnas rten dang slob dpon gnas dang dus// yo byad cho ga bzang po rnam drug la// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bzang po drug las/ dang po rab tu gnas bya'i rten yongs su dag pa bzang po ni/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ brdungs pa dang*/ ri mor bris pa dang*/ 'bur du byas pa la sogs pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga gsungs pa zhes dang*/ sku gzugs mtshan nyid ldan pa ste// zhi ba la sogs nyams dang ldan// tshad kyi tshad la phab cing bzang*// de 'dra rab tu gnas par bya// zhes gsungs shing*/ bzang po yongs su bzung ba las/ sku gzugs ras bris glegs bam rnams// de rgyu ji snyed rgyan gyis brgyan// bdag nyid lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bas// mdun du byas nas lhag gnas bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rten te chos sku'i rten mchod rten dang*/ longs sprul gyi rten rnams rang rang gi sku'i rnam gzhag ltar cha tshad dang ldan pa dang*/ glegs bam dang kun dga' ra ba dang*/ skyed mos tshal la sogs pa thams cad phyis bzo bos bya rgyu med pa zhig dgos te/ rten gyi bya ba yongs rdzogs nas// zhes 'byung bas 'dir yang rten phun sum tshogs pa 'di lta bu zhig grub pa lags/ gnyis pa rab tu gnas par byed pa'i slob dpon bzang ba ni/ dbang bskur legs par thob pa/ byang chub kyi sems kyis rgyud brlan pa/

dkyil 'khor gang dang gang byed pa de'i bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ de nyid bcu'i rnam gzhag shes shing*/ rab gnas kyi cho ga la mkhas shing byang chub pa zhig dgongs te/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ slob dpon de nyid bcu shes shing*// mtshan nyid kun dang yang dag ldan// phyag rgya gsang sngags cho ga shes// las rnams kun la mkhas pas so// zhes dang*/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ rdo rje slob dpon dbang thob nas// 'khor lo lnga yi de nyid sogs// rnam dag dkyil 'khor bsgom pa dang*// dbang bskur dang ni rab gnas sogs// slob dpon gyi ni phrin las dang*// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*// bla na med pa'i sdom pa sogs// rdo rje slob dpon kho na'i las// nyid yin gzhan gyis byar mi rung*// zhes gsungs pa lta bu yin la/ 'o na de nyid bcu po de gang yin zhe na/ dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang*// stangs stabs sngags dang 'dug stangs dang*// bzlas brjod sbyin sreg gtor ma dang*// las la sbyar dang slar bsdu'o// zhes slob dpon la mkho ba'i de nyid bcu dang*/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las gsungs pa'i grub chen ḍom+bhi pas/ gnas gsum dbang bskur gtor ma zlos gar dang*// phyir zlog pa dang dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang*// sdig sbyong ba dang gshegs su gsol ba ste// de nyid bcu zhes rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs// zhes cho ga'i de nyid bcu dang*/ rgyud 'bum lnga'i dgongs pa rin chen 'bar ba las/ rdo rje dril bu ye shes dang*// lha dang dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg dang*// sngags dang mdun mchod gtor ma dang*// dbang bskur de nyid rig pa yis// zhes de kho na nyid kyi de nyid bcu dang ldan pa zhig dgos te/ bzang po yongs bzung las/ de nyid bcu shes slob dpon ni// rab gnas byed par 'os pa yin// zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i rdo rje slob dpon de yang*/ rab dge slong*/

'bring dge tshul/ tha ma dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang ldan pa zhig nges par dgos te/ rten ni gsum las dge slong mchog /'bring ni dge tshul zhes bya ste// khyim na gnas pa tha ma'o// zhes gsungs shing*/ dus 'khor 'grel par/ sa thob ma gtogs khyim pas ni// rgyal po'i bla ma mi bya'o// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ lha khang sogs kyi rab gnas ni/ rtags can kyis ni bya ba nyid// gnas gcig dag na gsum yod na// khyim pa gos dkar can gyis min// zhes gsungs shing*/ mi dgos kha med kyi yan lag tu bsnyen sgrub sngon du song ba ni nges par gal che ste/ rtsa ltung gi gzhung las/ bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas par// dkyil 'khor las la 'jug pa dang*// zhes dang*/ de'i don 'grel she'u lo tsā ba chen pos/ mtshan dus grangs bsnyen gang rung ma song bar// dbang rab las la 'jug pa bdun pa yin// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig dgos pa lags/ gsum pa gang du rab tu gnas pa'i gnas bzang ba ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang mdor bstan las/ gang na sa skyong chos ldan zhing*// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sa phyogs chos ldan gyi rgyal pos skyong zhing phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe med cing*/ dam tshig la sel med pa snod min gyi skye bos dben pa zhig dgos te/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ tshes grangs ngan dang dus min dang*// gnas min cho ga mi ldan par// mkhas pas dkyil 'khor mi bri'o// bris na dogs pa med par 'chi// zhes gsungs pa'i gnas der sa rgyan gnam rgyan sogs kyis mdzes par bya dgos te/ bzang po yongs bzung las/ bla bre gdugs dkar ba dan dar// mang po rnams kyis yang dag mdzes// bdug spos btul ba'i dri zhim pa// yid 'phrog pa yis rab gnas par// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i gnas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gnas la co 'dri ba 'di lta bu mngon du gyur pa lags/ bzhi pa rab tu gnas pa'i dus bzang ba ni/

rab dpyid zla 'bring po nag pa zla ba sangs rgyas dbang bskur ba'i dus dang*/ dgun zla 'bring po rgyal gyi zla ba 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi dus gnyis kyi yar ngo'i gza' tshes 'dzom pa'i dus khyad par can nam/ 'bring zla ba gang rung gi yar ngo'i gza' tshes dang ldan pa/ tha ma mar ngo'i nyi shu brgyad yan gang rung gi gza' skar dus sbyor sogs 'dzom pa'i dus su bya dgos te/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ dpyid zla ra ba dpyid 'bring po// dgun zla dpyid kyi tha chung ngo*// dbyar zla ra ba dbyar 'bring po// dkar po'i phyogs kyi gnyis pa'am// zhes sogs zla ba shis pa dang*/ zla ba/ lhag pa/ phur bu/ pa sangs te gza' shis pa dang*/ chu stod/ snar ma/ gro zhun/ sbo/ lag snron/ snubs/ rgyal/ chu smad/ khrums smad de skar ma shis pa ste de rnams thams cad 'dzom pa'i dus nyi ma byang bgrod kyi zla ba yar ngo'i dus su shin tu shis pa yin te/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor dang ni rab gnas pa// yar gyi ngo la brtag par bya// gza' dang skar ma 'dzom gyur na// mar gyi ngo la'ang nyes pa med// ces gsungs shing*/ nyi ma byang bgrod kyi tshe dbang bskur dang rab gnas shin tu shis par gsungs te/ byang phyogs na tshe dang dpal 'byor dbang phyug la sogs pa rgyas par byed pa'i gnod sbyin stobs chen rnams yod pas rgyas pa'i las 'grub pa'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ba'i phyir na/ de ring gi gnas skabs su gza' skar sbyor byed phun sum tshogs pa dang 'grigs pa lags/ lnga pa rab tu gnas par mkho ba'i yo byad bzang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i yo byad dang*/ rab gnas kyi dus su dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad gya nom zhing khyad par du 'phags pa brel ba med par bsags nas dngos gzhi'i dus su g.yeng ba nam yang mi dgos pa bya dgos te/ rab tu gnas pa ni bkra shis pa'i yan lag yin pa'i phyir na/ 'dir sbyin pa'i bdag pos yo byad phun sum tshogs pa 'di lta bu 'grigs pas rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ba lags/

drug pa rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bzang ba ni/ bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ rab gnas mdo nas bshad pa med// 'on kyang mchod bstod bkra shis dang*// rgyal po'i mnga' dbul lta bu la// rab gnas yin zhes smra na smos// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdo lugs nas rab gnas kyi cho ga ma bshad cing*/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa las ni rab gnas kyi cho ga shin tu rgyas par bshad/ de yang rab tu gnas pa 'di bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i thabs bla na med pa yin par dgongs nas ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi kyang rgyud sde rin po che du ma'i gseb tshags su gsungs par ma zad/ rab gnas kyi rgyud chung zur du yang bka' stsal zhing*/ de dag gi dgongs pa bkral ba slob dpon zhi ba snying po'i mchod rten sgrub pa'i cho ga dang sku gzugs kyi rnam dbye gnyis/ slob dpon dge mtshan bshes gnyen gyi khrus kyi cho ga dang*/ pradz+nyā wa li ta'i spyan dbye'i cho ga slob dpon kun dga' snying po'i rab gnas kyi cho ga ste rgya gzhung lnga bzhugs pa yin la/ de dag la brten nas bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su yang bod la bka' drin che ba mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po rab tu gnas pa mdzad pa'i dus ya mtshan gyi ltas khyad par can du ma byung zhing rab gnas shin tu legs pas rang re kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas shing*/ sems can la bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa byung bar gyur/ bstan pa phyi dar la jo bo shrad+dhā ka ras rab gnas kyi gzhung thams cad bod du spyan drangs/ lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang po dpon slob gnyis kyis tho lding gser gyi lha khang gi rab gnas mdzad cing phyag len gyi rgyun mi nub par bya ba'i phyir sngar gyi gzhung lnga'i dgongs pa jo bo shrad+dhā'i phyag len ji lta ba bzhin du jo bo rin chen bzang pos sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa mdzad cing*/

de dag gi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'khrul pa'i dri ma thams cad zad par spangs pa rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la brten cing*/ rgyud sde bzhi char la sbyar chog pa rab gnas kyi cho ga don gsal ba mdzad de lugs 'di la 'di rab gnas kyi thog ma yin pas rgya gzhung lta bur khas blang bar bya ba yin no// de'i rjes su ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsang ba 'dus pa la sbyar ba'i rab gnas bkra shis brgya mtsho/ de'i dgongs pa bkral ba kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges kye rdor la brten pa'i rab gnas dge legs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba mdzad pa de gnyis ka'i dgongs pa bkral ba ngor chen dkon mchog dpal ldan gyis kye rdor la brten pa'i rab gnas dpal 'byor rgya mtsho zhes bya ba mdzad do// 'dir de dag gi sgo nas rab tu gnas pa legs par gyis shing*/ de la rgyas pa'i lugs nyin gsum ma/ 'bring nyin gnyis ma/ tha ma nyin gang ma mdzad pa'i phyag len ltar 'dir gang yin pa bshad/ de la dngos gzhi'i cho ga rnams legs par grub nas 'dir mjug gi skabs yin/ de la yang*/ gtor ma sbyin dang chos skyong bsgo// dkyil 'khor mchod de dngos grub blang*// bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol// yon bdag bsgo zhing shis pa brjod// rten mchog bsod nams yongs su bsngo// slob dpon mchod de dga' ston bya// slar yang shis pa rgyas par brjod// rjes bsdu sbyin sreg mjug don ni// zhes pa ltar don tshan bcu gsum yod pa las/ 'dir lnga pa yon bdag bsgo ba'i skabs su babs pa yin pas/ de la khyed kyis bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di lta bu zhes skabs thob sbyar te/ khyad par du 'phags pa 'di lta bu grub pa 'di la 'jig rten gyi khams su phan bde rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ khyed rang gi bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs pa dang*/

skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du lha dang mi'i mchod pa dpag tu med pa thob pa dang*/ tshe 'dir yang longs spyod rgya chen po 'byung ba'i rten 'brel du zhag bdun gyi bar mchod pa rgya chen po bya dgos shing*/ de nas ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa rgyun mi chad pa 'bul dgos te/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ de bzhin du yang sngags gnas las// chos ldan mchod pa byed pa dang*// de yi las kyi rnam smin gyis// skye ba ru ni mchod par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar mchod pa'i las la brtson par mdzod cig ces brjod/ de tsam gyi bshad pa rgyas par mi nus na sa bcad ma dor ba'i lung rnams bzhag kyang rung*/ drug pa shis pa brjod pa ni/ yon bdag la las bum chus gtor/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ yon bdag skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpar bskyed/ lag tu me tog 'dzin du bcug de la bgegs bskrad pa/ rdzas brgyad gtad pa rnams dkyus bzhin brjod/ tsā ru'i bza' ba yon bdag bzo bo sogs thams cad la drang*/ slob dpon gyis/ bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni// zo zhig sdig pa byang bar 'gyur// zhes brjod do// smras pa/ rab tu gnas pa'i yon bdag bsgo ba'i skabs// legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston spel ba'i tshul// rab gnas rgyud dang bla ma'i man ngag ltar// rang bzo spangs te myur ba nyid du bris// bdag blo dman zhing sbyangs pa chung ba'i phyir// mkhas pa dgyes pa'i legs bshad ma mchis mod// 'on te dad ldan slob mas bskul ba'i ngor// ha cang rgyas min mdor bsdus 'di sbyar ro// zhes pa 'di yang bsam yas pa dge slong kun dga' tshul khrims kyis bskul ba'i ngor na tshod rgan yang blo gros gzhon nur gyur pa shāka btsun lhun grub kyis dben gnas rmor dgon par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni skal bzang rnam grol lo// //shu bhaṃ// sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/

bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
